confirmedFromLocalSource: JDK HTTP redirects are disabled; page manually follows at most three HTTP requests and checks fixed same origin but not bound share identity.
page is GET-only, does not import response cookies, and bounds each response through the transport.
openShare sends POST /share/verify whenever an extraction code exists; findOwnShare and validateOwnShare can therefore POST and must not be used in a GET-only diagnostic.
normalizedShareUrl recognizes /s/1ID and equivalent /share/init?surl=ID, then preserves at most one valid pwd in canonical output.
legacy htmlNumber returns the first regex match without a structured container, key boundary, complete numeric value, duplicate check or owner/shareId common-object check.
jsoup 1.17.2 is already declared in production pom; no production dependency change is needed for an isolated nonexecuting parser.
diagnosticRecommendations: Use a separate diagnostic generation, never an official PASS receipt. Bind exact original child URL/record shareId/current session UID in memory and retain V2 failures.
Transport exposes GET only, https pan.baidu.com, no userinfo/port/fragment, bounded UTF-8 body, 30-second request timeout, no library redirects/retries, at most three manually verified requests.
Every redirect must retain bound share identity using only known /s/1ID or /share/init?surl=ID forms; reject unrelated same-origin routes, unknown query keys, duplicate query keys or changed pwd.

Decode UTF-8 strictly and parse HTML inertly. Report only whitelisted structural names/types/counts/path SHA and equality/uniqueness booleans. Do not save raw HTML, values, URLs, scripts, cookies or pwd.

Use regex only to diagnose candidate locations. Formal future owner proof needs one known structured share container with share_uk and shareid together, strict duplicate keys and field types, full decimal values, and exact UID/record/share matching.

Generic uk may describe the logged-in user and is not an independent share owner proof. Nested candidates, multiple containers, conflicts, missing fields, challenge/login/password pages or unrecognized script shape must STOP.
Never execute JavaScript, fetch script assets, call openShare/validateOwnShare/findOwnShare/createOwnShare, issue extraction POST, persist response cookies or change the session pair.
